nodes.label: .`scanning a mixer shows the confirm card and sends nothing`()
.`start mix Done shows a green banner and clears the card`()
.`start mix Unresolved holds the PREP and blocks scans`()
.`not sent keeps the card so the tap can be repeated`()
.`finish sends the cycleId of the current snapshot, not the one at scan time`()
.`a wrong machine on finish never sends`()
.`an unknown code is a red banner`()
.`a disabled machine shows the card but never sends`()
.`a blocked PREP never sends and refuses the scan`()
.`a block that appears while the card is open stops the tap`()
.`a scan while the card is open is refused`()
.`scans reach the machine flow only while the screen is active`()
.`a stage change while the card is open cancels it`()
.`the last production finishing reports the preparation complete`()
.`a production finish that is not the last says Production k finished`()
